name: Summon Elemental
rationale: Stone, Blaze, Kelp and a feather encode the four elemental bodies; Amethyst and a seal bind their finite manifestation.

parts.rationale: Iron mana/regeneration/cast-time crafting family; native focusing role

clues: Outer Plinths hold stone motif, kelp motif, resonant facet; the other required ingredients use Inner Plinths.
Leave the fourth outer Plinth clockwise from Paper empty.
Stone motif follows blank inscription clockwise.
Flame focus follows stone motif clockwise.
Kelp motif follows flame focus clockwise.
Feather motif follows kelp motif clockwise.
Resonant facet follows feather motif clockwise.
Protection seal follows resonant facet clockwise.
Blank inscription follows protection seal clockwise, across an unused outer Plinth.
